description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:362-367 — When every round of iterative deepening hits BudgetExceeded (any_round_budget_exceeded=true, line 335-351), the code returns Err(BudgetExceeded) at line 357 — correct. However if no round hits budget AND no path is found within MAX_DEPTH, the depth-probe DFS at line 365 can also return Err(Error::BudgetExceeded) via the ? operator. This Err propagates up as BudgetExceeded without setting any_round_budget_exceeded. The result is correct (we do return BudgetExceeded), but the code path bypasses the any_round_budget_exceeded flag entirely, making the flag's meaning misleading in docs: the flag comment says 'if every round hits the budget' but the probe budget exhaustion is a separate, undocumented path to BudgetExceeded. Not a correctness bug but the asymmetry should be documented or the flag logic unified.
title: BudgetExceeded all-rounds edge case: probe can also exceed budget
